# omgskills

omgskills is a Mac app and public web library for discovering, installing, and organizing AI agent skills.

## Public web library

- Skills index: https://omgskills.com/skills/
- Featured profiles: https://omgskills.com/profiles/openai/
- Editorial collections: https://omgskills.com/collections/starter-pack/
- Example skill page: https://omgskills.com/skills/openai/codex/code-review/

## Data

- Crawl 4 manifest: https://omgskills.com/data/crawl4/manifest.json
- v2 manifest fallback: https://omgskills.com/data/v2/manifest.json

The web library is generated from the same published catalog data used by the Mac app. Skill pages, profile pages, and collection pages are static HTML with canonical URLs and structured data.
